workflow: When a ship-loop has multiple long-running independent checks (CodeRabbit CLI, security audit subagent, broader e2e suite), run them all concurrently in the background and do the manual simplify-review pass yourself while waiting, rather than serializing.

For last-minute fix commits (like a rotation-soundness bug fix applied late in phase execution), prioritize a targeted simplify/security re-review of just that commit since it's most likely to carry rough edges.
